name: [POROUS PLIGHT] The Baseplate Project
desc:
WARNING: THIS GAME IS NOT FIT FOR PEOPLE WITH PHOTOSENSITIVE EPILEPSY. SOME TOWERS MAY CONTAIN EXTREME FLASHING LIGHTS AND LOUD SOUNDS. 

[Antiplate has released with 34 towers! Go play them right now.]

Towers. You've heard of them. But have you ever experienced them — at their rawest form?
Face the ULTIMATE Tower Obby experience: The Baseplate Project. Only for the most highly esteemed of tower connoisseurs.

YOU WILL FIND:
- Baseplates ☑️
- Towers ☑️
- AND (possibly) MORE! ☑️

-> A wide selection of 940 towers awaits you. Play any of them... or don't! The choice is yours.

Unexperienced players are advised to first play through towers using 'All-Jumps Mode' or 'Practice Mode'.

Play the OG Tower Game here: https://www.roblox.com/games/8562822414
